name: rail-droop
purpose: tedge = 100 ps; vdd droops from 0.95 V to 0.70 V between 20 and 180 ns (0.78 mV per tick) while vin = 0.85 V, so both stored values are limited by the falling span, also during a 20 ns and a 15 ns low phase in which the output stage holds; vin then drops to 0.4 V; vss slides from 0 to -0.08 V between 230 and 310 ns (0.5 mV per tick) during a 30 ns low phase, so vout follows vss while b holds and the input is read from the moving vss
